script:
Ke Accountant
I am an accountant at Health Hospital. After joining the company, I worked diligently, busy from morning till night every day. I never had the chance to have a proper romantic relationship. Until three months ago, I met Dr. Jia, who was newly transferred to the cardiac surgery department. She is the most gentle and kind angel in white in this world. She performed several major surgeries in a row after arriving and was said to be promoted to head of cardiac surgery soon. But I only dared to watch her from afar and didn't dare to express my feelings directly. Sometimes I would secretly take a few photos of her and look at them alone when I missed her.
January 17th was the first time I spoke with her. That day when I was leaving my office, I happened to see her collapse at my office door. I quickly helped her inside. Her face was pale, probably exhausted from just finishing surgery. I gave her some sugar water, and she regained consciousness. I helped her back to her office. When I returned, I found a pen at my office door. It must have been dropped by Dr. Jia when she collapsed. I picked it up and saw cute rabbit stickers on it. So her heart was so girlish too.
January 24th was the most heartbreaking day for me. Dr. Jia left just like that, and I hadn't had time to tell her how much I loved her. I saw the death report that Nurse Wang from the operating room showed me, which stated that Dr. Jia died of heart failure due to overwork. I thought she was so foolish - no matter how hard you work, you shouldn't harm your own body.
During my night shift, I found her office door unlocked. I went in and sat in her chair, looking at the things she used to use. Her cup was still there. I opened the cup and saw what seemed to be some different crystals inside. What could they be? Even with just a hint of suspicion, I couldn't let it go. I secretly poured out those tiny crystals, wrapped them up, and took them back, thinking of finding a colleague to test them. But I never expected those crystals to be chronic poison! It killed my beloved Dr. Jia! Who could be so cruel? I must find out.
In mid-January, the hospital suddenly discovered a large discrepancy in the cardiac surgery equipment expenses, and it was all blamed on me in the end. I don't know what happened. I never made false accounts or embezzled a penny, but the hospital has already started investigating me and said they would hand me over to the police soon. I think someone must be framing me. I can't just let myself be slaughtered.
January 26th, in the morning I went to Deputy Director Pan's office, wanting to explain the equipment expense matter to him and gain his trust. When I reached the door, I heard Deputy Director Pan and Director Zhen arguing inside. I didn't dare go in and just stood outside listening secretly. I heard Deputy Director Pan say to Director Zhen: "Don't think you can threaten me for life just because you have something on me. Do you think I don't know how Dr. Jia really died? Your little tricks can't fool me. And that money - you dared to embezzle equipment expenses and frame that young accountant. You really aren't afraid of death!" Director Zhen also angrily retorted: "That money ended up in your pocket anyway. If we're going down, we're going down together. Revealing everything would cost us our heads. Try touching me and see what happens!"
Hearing footsteps coming out, I quickly left and hastily bumped into Nurse Wang. I hurried back to my office and slumped in my chair. So it was Director Zhen - he killed my beloved Dr. Jia and embezzled the equipment expenses to frame me. I must avenge Dr. Jia.
February 3rd at 10 AM, I called Director Zhen in advance, arranging to meet him at 21:00 in the office that evening. On the surface, I would threaten him with the equipment expense matter for a huge hush money, but actually, I wanted him to pay with his life for my beloved Dr. Jia!
[February 3rd - Night of the Incident]
18:00 - An operation in the operating room had just ended. I took out prepared surgical clothes, cap, and mask, disguised myself, and entered the operating room to steal a scalpel. Since I'm just an accountant, I'm the least likely to have contact with scalpels, which could reduce my suspicion.
18:20 - I threw the surgical clothes I took off into the abandoned storage room on the second floor, the place least likely to be discovered.
18:30 - I prepared to go home and return in two hours to meet Director Zhen. I met Nurse Wang at the front desk. She asked why I left work half an hour late today. I said there were too many accounts and I was delayed a bit.
21:05 - I arrived at Health Hospital, avoiding the front desk to prevent being seen by Nurse Wang, and went up to the second floor.
21:10 - I reached Director Zhen's office and saw Wei Daughter sitting in Director Zhen's office. Director Zhen was eating from a lunch box. When Director Zhen saw me arrive, he told the girl to go home first.
21:20 - Director Zhen and I kept pretending to negotiate terms to distract his attention. I walked to his side and tried to stab the knife into his heart when he wasn't prepared, but he reacted quickly, grabbed the blade with his hand, and snatched the knife away. We struggled in the office for a while. In the end, I couldn't beat him and was even cut on the base of my index finger by the scalpel. I had to flee his office in panic.
21:25 - I left the hospital and went to a nearby mall to buy some things, shopping for about an hour.
22:25 - I saw the girl who was just in Director Zhen's office enter the mall restroom, then I went home.
acts_goal: Find the real culprit of this case, try not to expose the fact that you had a conflict with the deceased.
